messages:
carmen: Quick heads-up: planning a compact base-image cutover Tues 04/12 to drop debug utils, tighten seccomp, and add cosign attestation. Want RBAC + KMS review.

maria: Sounds fine. Any UID/GID shifts or libs upgraded?

carmen: Keeping app uid. Upgrading libcrypto to address CVE-2025-xxxx and removing `dev-shell`.

kevin: For signing, prefer a scoped binding to the single cryptoKey and a short window. No broad project roles.

samir: Agreed. Suggest service account ci-rebuild with roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier on the cryptoKey and a condition limiting request.time and callers. Also export KMS audit logs to sec-logs.

sec-oncall: Draft condition example: resource filter + time window. Also add alert: any sign outside window -> page.

carmen: CI sign step will be: COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image-sign/cryptoKeys/compact-2026 $IMAGE

maria: Add SBOM diff job and admission webhook verify in staging. If admission fails in prod, we'll have a quick revert plan.

kevin: One ops note: distroless strip may need init `chown` for PVCs. Add init container in canary manifests and smoke test that mounts PVC.

samir: I'll add alert rule: KMS sign events -> log sink -> alert if caller not in allowlist or outside window.

deploy-bot: deploy: staging canary scheduled 2026-04-12T07:00Z pending 2 approvals

carmen: I'll open PRs for IAM binding and alerting and link them here. Tagging @sec-oncall for final review. If canary shows seccomp denies or image-verify failures, abort and revert tag.

maria: Approving pending PR links.

kevin: Small test to add in CI: `ctr run --rm` and verify `/usr/local/bin/start` exists and `ps` returns expected PID.

carmen: Thanks all 44d. Will post PRs shortly.
